paper_title: Fair-PP A Synthetic Dataset for Aligning LLM with Personalized   Preferences of Social Equity
caption:
(b) P6: Matching statistics

Personalized preference analysis: (a) we calculate the Jensen-Shannon similarity between seven personas.  (b) Targeting Persona 6 (Abbreviated as P6), we analyze preference matching frequency with other personas and quantify the number of questions in each distinct frequency tier, then
(c) For persona 6’s unique preferences, we list the top-5 most frequent social groups and equity topics.
